scenes.section: Start with something you already know

lines.raw: Like a bus park.
lines.say: Like a bus park.

lines.raw: Instead of every village running its own bus to every other village, buses meet at a central bus park, and passengers change there.
lines.say: Instead of every village running its own bus to every other village, buses meet at a central bus park, and passengers change there.

lines.raw: A health network is the bus park for health data: each hospital, clinic or lab connects **once**, and the network connects it to everyone else.
lines.say: A health network is the bus park for health data: each hospital, clinic or lab connects once, and the network connects it to everyone else.

scenes.section: Start with something you already know

lines.raw: The idea in one sentence.
lines.say: The idea in one sentence.

lines.raw: Without networks, every clinic would need a separate link to every hospital, lab and plan: thousands of links.
lines.say: Without networks, every clinic would need a separate link to every hospital, lab and plan: thousands of links.

lines.raw: Networks replace them with **one connection each**, plus shared rules about who may ask for what.
lines.say: Networks replace them with one connection each, plus shared rules about who may ask for what.

lines.raw: Health information exchanges (HIEs).
lines.say: Health information exchanges (H I E's).

lines.raw: An **HIE** (health information exchange) is an organisation, often regional or state-wide, that moves clinical data between local hospitals, clinics, labs and, increasingly, health plans.
lines.say: An H I E (health information exchange) is an organisation, often regional or state-wide, that moves clinical data between local hospitals, clinics, labs and, increasingly, health plans.

lines.raw: HIEs share data in three common ways.
lines.say: H I E's share data in three common ways.

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: **Directed (push)**. How it works: One provider sends data to a known receiver through the HIE. Robert example: Dr. Nguyen's clinic sends a referral note to an eye doctor.
lines.say: Directed (push). How it works: One provider sends data to a known receiver through the H I E. Robert example: Doctor Nguyen's clinic sends a referral note to an eye doctor.

lines.raw: **Query (pull)**. How it works: A provider searches the HIE for a patient's records from other places. Robert example: An ER doctor looks up Robert's medicines and recent results.
lines.say: Query (pull). How it works: A provider searches the H I E for a patient's records from other places. Robert example: An E R doctor looks up Robert's medicines and recent results.

lines.raw: **Event notifications**. How it works: The HIE watches ADT (admit, discharge, transfer) messages and alerts subscribers when their patient is seen. Robert example: Dr. Nguyen's clinic is told the same day that Robert visited an ER.
lines.say: Event notifications. How it works: The H I E watches A D T (admit, discharge, transfer) messages and alerts subscribers when their patient is seen. Robert example: Doctor Nguyen's clinic is told the same day that Robert visited an E R.

lines.raw: What travels through an HIE is the data from earlier lessons: HL7 v2 ADT messages and lab results, **C-CDA** documents such as CCDs and discharge summaries, and increasingly FHIR.
lines.say: What travels through an H I E is the data from earlier lessons: HL7 v2 A D T messages and lab results, C-CDA documents such as C C D's and discharge summaries, and increasingly F H I R.

lines.raw: National networks and TEFCA.
lines.say: National networks and T E F C A.

lines.raw: Regional HIEs are good for local care.
lines.say: Regional H I E's are good for local care.

lines.raw: But Americans travel and move, so **national networks** grew up to connect EHRs across states.
lines.say: But Americans travel and move, so national networks grew up to connect E H R's across states.

lines.raw: Examples include **eHealth Exchange**, **Carequality** and **CommonWell**.
lines.say: Examples include eHealth Exchange, Carequality and CommonWell.

lines.raw: Each had its own agreement, so connecting the networks to each other was the next problem.
lines.say: Each had its own agreement, so connecting the networks to each other was the next problem.

lines.raw: TEFCA.
lines.say: T E F C A.

lines.raw: The **Trusted Exchange Framework and Common Agreement**: a national set of rules, called for by the 21st Century Cures Act (lesson 2), so that different networks can connect to each other under **one agreement**.
lines.say: The Trusted Exchange Framework and Common Agreement: a national set of rules, called for by the 21st Century Cures Act (lesson 2), so that different networks can connect to each other under one agreement.

lines.raw: Joining is **voluntary**.
lines.say: Joining is voluntary.

lines.raw: QHIN.
lines.say: Q H I N.

lines.raw: A **Qualified Health Information Network**: a network approved to exchange data under TEFCA.
lines.say: A Qualified Health Information Network: a network approved to exchange data under T E F C A.

lines.raw: The first QHINs were designated in late 2023.
lines.say: The first Q H I N's were designated in late 2023.

lines.raw: Providers and plans join through a QHIN, or through a member of one.
lines.say: Providers and plans join through a Q H I N, or through a member of one.

lines.raw: Exchange purposes.
lines.say: Exchange purposes.

lines.raw: TEFCA lists the reasons data may be requested, such as **treatment**, **payment**, **health care operations**, **public health**, **government benefits** and **individual access** (a patient getting their own data).
lines.say: T E F C A lists the reasons data may be requested, such as treatment, payment, health care operations, public health, government benefits and individual access (a patient getting their own data).

lines.raw: Not every purpose required an answer from the start; they are being phased in.
lines.say: Not every purpose required an answer from the start; they are being phased in.

lines.raw: Clinic.
lines.say: Clinic.

lines.raw: Joins a network that is, or belongs to, a QHIN.
lines.say: Joins a network that is, or belongs to, a Q H I N.

lines.raw: Its QHIN.
lines.say: Its Q H I N.

lines.raw: Passes the request to the other QHINs under the Common Agreement.
lines.say: Passes the request to the other Q H I N's under the Common Agreement.

lines.raw: Other QHINs.
lines.say: Other Q H I N's.

lines.raw: Find participants that may hold the patient's records.
lines.say: Find participants that may hold the patient's records.

lines.raw: Answer.
lines.say: Answer.

lines.raw: Documents (often C-CDA) come back through the same path.
lines.say: Documents (often C-CDA) come back through the same path.

lines.raw: Patient matching: the hard part.
lines.say: Patient matching: the hard part.

lines.raw: The US has **no single national patient ID** used by every system.
lines.say: The U S has no single national patient I D used by every system.

lines.raw: Networks match people using name, date of birth, sex, address, phone and each organisation's own IDs.
lines.say: Networks match people using name, date of birth, sex, address, phone and each organisation's own I D's.

lines.raw: Small differences cause **missed matches** (records not found) or, worse, **wrong matches** (someone else's records).
lines.say: Small differences cause missed matches (records not found) or, worse, wrong matches (someone else's records).

lines.raw: In the US: Robert visits Emily's cousin in Denver, October 2025.
lines.say: In the U S: Robert visits Emily's cousin in Denver, October 2025.

lines.raw: Robert feels unwell and visits an urgent care clinic in **Denver, Colorado**.
lines.say: Robert feels unwell and visits an urgent care clinic in Denver, Colorado.

lines.raw: The clinic has never seen him.
lines.say: The clinic has never seen him.

lines.raw: The clinic's EHR belongs to a network that takes part in **TEFCA**.
lines.say: The clinic's E H R belongs to a network that takes part in T E F C A.

lines.raw: It sends a **treatment** query with Robert's name, birth date, sex and address.
lines.say: It sends a treatment query with Robert's name, birth date, sex and address.

lines.raw: In minutes, the Denver doctor sees his diabetes, his medicines (metformin, lisinopril) and his HbA1c of 9.4%.
lines.say: In minutes, the Denver doctor sees his diabetes, his medicines (metformin, lisinopril) and his H b A 1 c of 9.4 percent.

lines.raw: Why networks matter for data.
lines.say: Why networks matter for data.

lines.raw: For a health plan, an HIE is often the **fastest** clinical data source: ADT alerts arrive the same day and C-CDAs arrive within days, while claims take weeks.
lines.say: For a health plan, an H I E is often the fastest clinical data source: A D T alerts arrive the same day and C-CDAs arrive within days, while claims take weeks.

lines.raw: But every record from a network is only as good as its match.
lines.say: But every record from a network is only as good as its match.

lines.raw: Analysts track match rates and check suspicious links, such as a "member" with two different birth dates.
lines.say: Analysts track match rates and check suspicious links, such as a "member" with two different birth dates.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: **HIEs** move clinical data between local providers by push, query and event notifications (ADT alerts).
lines.say: H I E's move clinical data between local providers by push, query and event notifications (A D T alerts).

lines.raw: **National networks** connect EHRs across states; **TEFCA** lets networks connect to each other under one voluntary agreement.
lines.say: National networks connect E H R's across states; T E F C A lets networks connect to each other under one voluntary agreement.

lines.raw: **QHINs** are the networks approved to exchange data under TEFCA, for set purposes such as treatment and individual access.
lines.say: Q H I N's are the networks approved to exchange data under T E F C A, for set purposes such as treatment and individual access.

lines.raw: The US has no single patient ID, so networks **match** on name, birth date and other details; mistakes cause missing or mixed-up records.
lines.say: The U S has no single patient I D, so networks match on name, birth date and other details; mistakes cause missing or mixed-up records.

lines.raw: For plans, network feeds are fast clinical data, but only as reliable as the patient match.
lines.say: For plans, network feeds are fast clinical data, but only as reliable as the patient match.
